suppress.notes:
braces 3.0.3, GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm (CVSS 7.5, published 2026-09-18): deeply nested brace patterns exhaust the stack and crash the Node.js process. No fixed version exists; every braces release through 3.0.3 is affected.
Why it's accepted (2026-10-20): - braces is a dev-only build dependency (tailwindcss -> chokidar / micromatch -> braces) of src/StockAnalyzer.Api/package.json, used only to build wwwroot/css/styles.css from src/input.css. - It never reaches production. styles.css is committed, node_modules isn't, and the deploy builds the image from a clean checkout with no npm install, so the Tailwind step is skipped and the runtime image holds only the dotnet publish output. - The patterns it parses are the content globs in tailwind.config.js, which we write. No outside input reaches it.
Re-check by the until date: drop this entry once braces ships a fix (then `npm update braces` in src/StockAnalyzer.Api) or tailwindcss stops depending on it.
